title: BEYOND NEXT WORD PREDICTION: DEVELOPING COMPREHENSIVE EVALUATION FRAMEWORKS FOR MEASURING LLM PERFORMANCE ON REAL WORLD APPLICATIONS
reasoning: The paper explicitly proposes an evaluation framework designed to measure abstract qualities including ethics and morality. It argues that game-based evaluation environments are unique because they can reveal hidden biases or 'immoral actions' (such as cheating or dishonesty) in models that are otherwise obscured by static benchmarks.
